gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi has big open curves in every small letter. Conthrax up top is a wide, single-stroke display face, and the plain sans below it gives that rigid geometry room to breathe.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada reads modern and a bit blocky, with a high x-height and terminals that stop well away from the stem. Anek Kannada is the quiet partner here, while Conthrax earns its keep big and short, where its wire-straight strokes can show off.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-latin: Neutral is the first impression of Anek Latin, whose tall lowercase nearly meets the capitals and whose shapes stay held open. Conthrax leads with a marker-like line, and a longer run of text below it would feel steady, unhurried and easy to follow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-malayalam: Conthrax has diagonals as heavy as its verticals, which gives every capital a stamped, industrial look. Anek Malayalam is the softer partner, its curves left slightly unclosed and its capitals sitting close to lowercase height.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-odia: Conthrax draws everything with straight-edged, constant strokes, like cut metal. Anek Odia carries a longer page easily, its rounds left unlatched like open hooks and its capitals only just above the lowercase.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-tamil: Modern in feel, Anek Tamil has big round bowls. Conthrax, with letters that look cut from wire, leads above, and a longer stretch of text below it would feel loose and open, its c and s shapes half unwrapped.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu sets a reading rhythm of wide, tall bowls, with rounds left unsealed like an unlatched hook. But Conthrax above it never shifts weight along a curve, so the plain sans below looks softer and friendlier by comparison.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-anuphan: Conthrax offers no calligraphic shading at all, just wide geometric letters with a lowercase so tall its capitals barely stand out. Anuphan then supplies big round bowls and open curves with clear gaps, which is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-arimo: Arimo reads with a tall mean line and spacious gaps in its rounded letters, so text looks light and tidy. And Conthrax, cut from one gauge of tubing, gives that gentle body a firm, uniform frame above it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-armata: Armata has generous gaps between characters and lowercase bodies that fill most of the letter height. Armata and Conthrax both stay free of flourish, though the heading holds a constant stroke weight while the sans below opens its rounds.
